description: Source code for web services handling authentication and contact synchronization in a Google App Engine environment, including request handlers, contact data serialization, and database reset functionality.

classes.name: BaseWebServiceHandler
classes.description: Base class providing authentication and validation helpers for web service handlers.

classes.name: Authenticate
classes.description: Handles login/authentication requests, returning an auth token.

classes.name: SyncContacts
classes.description: Handles contact synchronization requests, including fetching and updating contacts.

classes.name: ResetDatabase
classes.description: Handles database reset via cron, restoring sample contacts.

classes.name: UpdatedContactData
classes.description: Serializes contact information into JSON format for sync responses.

classes.name: DeletedContactData
classes.description: Serializes deleted contact info into JSON for sync responses.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Processes client authentication based on username and password.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates client credentials using username and authtoken.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Handles POST requests for authentication and contact sync.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Handles GET requests for debugging or database reset.

methods.name: get_updated_contacts
methods.description: Retrieves contacts updated since last sync state.

methods.name: process_client_changes
methods.description: Processes contact changes sent from client.

methods.name: list_contains_contact
methods.description: Checks if contact list contains a specific contact.

methods.name: safe_attr
methods.description: Safely retrieves attribute from JSON object.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Sets up WSGI application with URL routing and runs it.
